# LLM Wiki Template

> A template for a persistent, compounding markdown knowledge base maintained by an LLM assistant. You curate sources in `raw/`; the assistant reads each one once, writes linked pages in `wiki/`, and keeps them current. No vector database, no re-retrieval on every question.

## Core documentation

- [README](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/README.md): What it is, why it differs from RAG, getting started, folder map, skills, and everyday workflow.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Always-on rules for structure, frontmatter schema, citations, and operations. Under 8 KB so any agent can load it cheaply.
- [Migration notes](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/docs/migration.md): Guidance for derived notebooks.
- [Improvement catalog](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/IMPROVEMENTS.md): 100 internal correctness/performance candidates, many resolved.
- [Discoverability catalog](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/DISCOVERABILITY.md): SEO and distribution candidates.

## Scripts

- [lint.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/lint.py): Structure, link integrity, stale claims, and integration gaps.
- [refresh.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/refresh.py): Detect changed sources and report pages to revisit.
- [wiki_search.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/wiki_search.py): Bounded-token search over the notebook.
- [wiki_index.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/wiki_index.py): Build the compact machine-readable index.
- [raw_manifest.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/raw_manifest.py): Manifest of `raw/` files with hashes.
- [extract_outline.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/extract_outline.py): Heading outline and chunk plan for a raw file.
- [web_tools.py](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/scripts/web_tools.py): HTML-to-markdown conversion and rate-limited fetch helpers.

## Playbooks (skills)

- [wiki-writing](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-writing): Create or revise notebook prose with templates and citation rules.
- [wiki-ingest](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-ingest): Integrate curated material into the wiki.
- [wiki-query](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-query): Answer from the notebook and file durable answers.
- [wiki](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki): Read-only answers.
- [wiki-maintenance](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-maintenance): Refresh and lint.
- [wiki-delete](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-delete): Remove a subject safely.
- [wiki-router](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/tree/main/.agents/skills/wiki-router): Map a request to one playbook.

## Compatibility

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and Codex via symlinks to the same `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/` source of truth. Python 3.9+; stdlib only; no dependencies.

## Optional

- [Full context](https://github.com/jonyfs/llm-wiki-template/blob/main/llms-full.txt): README, AGENTS.md, and skill summaries concatenated for single-fetch agents.
